notes: [S119-01] The opening continues an assertion that a morphism is a local immersion of smooth analytic spaces, with a relative variant. This assertion is carried as manuscript background; no omitted antecedent or missing page was supplied and no proof was checked.

[S119-02] The canceled passage proposes a finiteness hypothesis and then a criterion involving the two maps to D0. Its two successive displayed versions remain distinct: the second adds vertical identifications and its own comma and et. The criterion itself is reported, not proved.

[S119-03] The large canceled diagram has six objects and seven arrows, including a double-shaft bottom arrow. Its two vertical arrows carry single vertically oriented wavy labels. The labels and heads were counted independently of the oblique cancellation strokes. This is a visual/notation check, not a proof that the displayed square is cartesian.

[S119-04] The live paragraph claims equivalence of local immersion and local monomorphism in the smooth or relatively smooth setting, and says that the latter notion makes sense in any site. Those claims were transcribed as background only. The non-agreeing written form imm. local is preserved at both occurrences.

[S119-05] Diagram (178), the following prose and diagram (179) claim canonical maps from the Dd to X=D0 and their commutativity. The assigned page provides the local notation used here, but the assertions were not independently proved. In particular, a categorical expectation did not supply missing arrowheads.

[S119-06] The marginal note places script D as a category in (An)_{D0}. Its literal category notation and first abbreviated catég. are retained; H’s expansion into des objets and au-dessus de is not source wording. This is the manuscript’s assertion, not a reconstructed definition.

[S119-07] Visual spelling checks preserve tt, can with a raised t and baseline point, mono without a point, and def without an accent. The cancelled abbreviation is now \unsure{codimens.|codim} after blind audit B03; the earlier unqualified codimens. reading is superseded. The shortened relative adverb remains marked locally because its raised ending is not fully clear.

[S119-08] The initial underline begins within immersion and runs beneath locale. Its graphic representation uses the observed fractional span and does not claim an exact letter boundary. A separate canceled word lies beneath analytiques; its surviving loops, upright and dot do not permit recovering the full word.

[S119-09] In (179), X is clearly drawn over a D0-like earlier layer. The prior layer is not read with the same confidence as the final X. The top connector’s short terminal downward turn is drawn literally, while its intended direction remains uncertain.

[S119-10] The compressed upper-region word in the canceled diagram admits comm., can., and canon. It is rendered as a standalone region annotation. The mathematical desirability of commutativity did not settle the reading or attach it to an arrow.

[S119-11] The sheet is upright. The 27 main writing baselines counted here include the canceled insertion, prose and diagram rows; the diagonal margin and separate number labels are inventoried separately. Formula labels (178), (179), and pencil foliation 118 were read directly. Only the assigned scan 119 packet was used.

Blind comparison: all 18 differing boxes were adjudicated on their fresh crops. The cancelled lower word now tentatively reads ordinaire and analytiques is placed as its raised insertion. Two cancelled abbreviations/words gained local doubts. The colon-like mark after ailleurs remains uncertain against à. The hollow terminal loop in (178) is reproduced explicitly; no directional meaning is inferred from it.
